Supreme Court rebukes Bihar judge over contempt conviction of police officer

During a hearing of the judge’s appeal against an October 8 High Court order that described the conviction of a Bihar Superintendent of Police as “peculiar” and “unprecedented”, a three‑judge Supreme Court bench chaired by Chief Justice Surya Kant rebuked the Bihar judicial officer, telling him “Don’t try to become Baahubali” and warning against acting like a hero, after the judge had convicted the police officer of contempt and filed an FIR against him.
